items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And I was playing with a fella by the name of Saunders King’s Band, Saunders King. And I was the drummer.

ctx.x: And I was playing with a fella by the name of Saunders King’s Band, Saunders King. And I was the drummer. Did you ever hear of Mingus?
